name: Ember Garden
description: A lamplighter's night in a walled garden: relight the lanterns, net the moths that snuff them out, and keep the garden glowing for as long as you can.
controls: WASD/arrows move, J/E light (hold to rekindle a dark lantern), Space/K swing the net, Shift/L dash, P pause, M mute. Menus: mouse, arrows + Enter, or gamepad D-pad + A. Remap keys with ⌨.

achievements.name: First Light
achievements.description: Rekindle a lantern that a moth snuffed out.

achievements.name: Moth Catcher
achievements.description: Net 25 moths in a single night. Unlocks the azure flame.

achievements.name: Full Bloom
achievements.description: Start wave 5 or later with every lantern still burning.

achievements.name: Ember Master
achievements.description: Score 10,000 glow in a single night.
